content: For offline GitOps manifest updates in Go, sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml is purpose-built for manipulating Kubernetes Resource Configuration as YAML while preserving structure/comments; go list shows v0.21.1 available. gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1 is smaller and enough for whole-document typed rewrite, but kyaml is the better fit when updating existing manifests without clobbering operator edits. client-go is unnecessary because the scaffolder edits Git files, not the live cluster API.
